issues.description: Duplicate React imports in step-3/page.tsx causing build error: 'useState' and 'useEffect' are defined multiple times (lines 2 and 3 have two separate import statements from 'react'). This causes a module build failure and 500 errors, breaking Fast Refresh and causing RSC fetch failures that affect the entire dev server.
issues.root_cause: Line 2 has `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'` and line 3 has `import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'` — two separate react imports with overlapping named exports.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch errors on auth page — 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated multiple times, causing the entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: The build instability from the step-3 duplicate imports is causing Fast Refresh full reloads and RSC payload fetch failures, which likely exacerbates hydration issues. The hydration error itself may also stem from dynamic content rendered differently on server vs client.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import line that only imports useState and useEffect — the second import already includes those plus useCallback and useRef, making the first redundant and causing the build error.
